reviewed_builder.inspection: Text inspection only; builder not imported or run.

findings.finding: final mode hardcodes technical_phase_complete_final_save_pending and a next implementation phase for any source argument, including the default pre-P24 START. It does not require or bind the independent review, Director adoption or concrete retained-refusal outcome. At review time the supplied candidate is frozen_for_independent_review_not_adopted.
findings.required_action: Freeze final only against the actual reviewed/published P24 core revision. Bind ADOPTION/OUTCOME/exact reviewer and candidate identities, and derive next action from that accepted outcome. A retained-refusal outcome needs its concrete alternative; it cannot unconditionally direct implementation. Record technical stop, completed/incomplete steps, documentary result references and remaining delivery in CHECKPOINT/HANDOFF. This may be enforced by builder validation plus explicit source argument; do not run final with default START.

findings.finding: Current final recovery payload copies only initializer, documentary runner, attempt001 transfer patch, rejected early ZIP, and the generic reconciliation/builder files. Git ls-tree includes only files already committed under the P24 prefix. It therefore has no mechanism or complete inventory to demonstrate preservation of unique still-unpublished author revisions, observed draft, review failures/scripts/results, final documentary/publication evidence and unresolved operations.
findings.required_action: Before freeze, explicitly reconcile all unique recovery files against the final Git payload or archive payload. Include exact design/path/history/attempt001-003, records/design-observed-draft, author REVISION-RECORD, independent reviewer evidence and original failures, recovery auditor scripts/failure records, and relevant publication/check records unless byte-equal retained at pinned Git sources. Preserve original modes as metadata where material; exclude reproducible extractions and installed environments. A recovery/source manifest should identify which bytes are included, externally pinned, or reproducible.

findings.finding: Generated final HANDOFF points to repository/.../path-design-p24/DECISION.md. The frozen candidate manifest binds DECISION-CANDIDATE.md; no DECISION.md was supplied. Independent review/adoption also need exact artifact links or source paths, rather than an unspecified independent review.
findings.required_action: Point the handoff to the actually published DECISION-CANDIDATE.md and exact ADOPTION/OUTCOME/review/control artifacts. Keep candidate-byte identity distinct from separate adoption; do not silently rename/rewrite the frozen candidate.

findings.finding: Recover prompt correctly blocks a second phase when the technical stop is reached and delivery is incomplete. Continue prompt only says reconcile P24 delivery then implement; the no-implementation condition is not explicit for missing/mismatched final delivery. It also unconditionally assumes adoption.
findings.required_action: Both final prompts must require matching final save/receipt/live terminal evidence before selecting the next technical phase; otherwise finish delivery only and stop. After confirmed delivery, follow the actual accepted next action or wait. Preserve the single-phase/fresh-host/no-H0-H1 boundaries.

findings.finding: Builder writes the same output ZIP with mode w and extracts into packages/<kind>/verification without ensuring a fresh empty directory. A repeat can overwrite a reviewed artifact and leave stale extracted files, while hash checks cover only listed payloads.
findings.required_action: Use a fresh distinct attempt directory and exclusive/no-overwrite freeze, or explicitly assert both output and extraction target are absent before writing. Verify extracted inventory exactly equals the manifest plus manifest. Never rebuild the already saved early archive.

findings.finding: New HISTORICAL-DEPENDENCIES correctly wraps inherited P23 paths and identifies the exact nested amendment. Its receipt_library_file_id is a hardcoded identifier not independently established by the archived amendment receipt contents inspected in this review.
findings.required_action: Bind that receipt identifier to the observed Library response/reconciliation artifact before claiming it independently verified; retain it as root-supplied provenance if the independent source is not packaged.

positive_findings: Required ten root filenames are generated.
Repository snapshots are read from explicit Git objects and each binding is compared to its declared source bytes.
Payload manifest excludes itself and records per-member bytes/SHA256.
Future P24 save receipt remains external to frozen package; final package does not pretend to contain its future receipt.
Disposable-host boundary occurs in README, both prompts and HOST-ENVIRONMENT; no runtime reconstruction is instructed for P24.
Original R01/R02 done and R03-R05 unfinished/P02 in_progress/PR274 draft-open are retained.
Recovery prompt separates early unfinished phase from post-stop delivery-only recovery.
Inherited historical dependency path-base ambiguity from early preflight is corrected.
limitations: No final archive exists in this review; no final package acceptance or save is claimed.
